The apothem is \(\sqrt{3}\) cm, and the height is \(1\) cm, so the slant height is

\[
l=\sqrt{1^2+(\sqrt3)^2}=\sqrt{4}=2\text{ cm}.
\]

Each lateral triangular face has area

\[
\frac12(2)(2)=2\text{ cm}^2.
\]

With 6 faces, the lateral surface area is

\[
6\cdot 2=12\text{ cm}^2.
\]

\[
\boxed{12}
\]
